records.jp: あれ、確かこの辺にあったはずなんだけどなぁ。<CR>どこにいったんだろ
records.en_original: Huh, I could've sworn it was here. I wonder where it went.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, I could've sworn it was here. I wonder where it went.
records.en: Huh? I was sure it was around here.<CR>Where did it go?

records.jp: そろそろここに置いてる本も溜まってきましたもんね。<CR>この機会に整理します？
records.en_original: These books sure have started to pile up. This might be a good chance to organize them. What do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: These books sure have started to pile up. This might be a good chance to organize them. What do you think?
records.en: The books here are starting to pile up too.<CR>Want to use this chance to sort them out?

records.jp: そうだね。そうした方がいいかも
records.en_original: Yeah, good idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, good idea.
records.en: Yeah. Maybe we should.

records.jp: 棚に置けたら一番なんだけど、場所ないしなぁ
records.en_original: These shelves are the best place, but looks like they're full.
records.en_auxiliary: These shelves are the best place, but looks like they're full.
records.en: Putting them on the shelves would be best, but there isn't any room.

records.jp: ジャンルごとに小分けして山にするというのは<CR>どうでしょうか？　物理学とか、生物学とか
records.en_original: Why don't we separate them into piles by genre?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we separate them into piles by genre?
records.en: How about sorting them into piles by genre?<CR>Physics, biology, and so on.

records.jp: いや、結構ジャンルがばらけてるみたい。<CR>その方法だと逆に場所取りそう
records.en_original: There are too many genres, I think that would end up just taking up more space.
records.en_auxiliary: There are too many genres, I think that would end up just taking up more space.
records.en: No, the genres seem pretty scattered.<CR>That method might actually take up more space.

records.jp: じゃあ、日本十進分類法の順番で重ねるとか
records.en_original: What about the Dewey Decimal System then?
records.en_auxiliary: What about the Dewey Decimal System then?
records.en: Then maybe stack them in Nippon Decimal Classification order.

records.jp: 何それ？
records.en_original: What's that?
records.en_auxiliary: What's that?
records.en: What's that?

records.jp: 図書館で使われている本の分類方法です
records.en_original: It's the system that libraries use to sort books.
records.en_auxiliary: It's the system that libraries use to sort books.
records.en: It's a book classification system used in libraries.

records.jp: ほら、図書館で借りた本って<CR>背表紙に番号の書かれたシールが貼ってあるでしょう？
records.en_original: When you borrow a book from the library, there's usually a little sticker with a number on the spine, right?
records.en_auxiliary: When you borrow a book from the library, there's usually a little sticker with a number on the spine, right?
records.en: You know how books borrowed from a library<CR>have a sticker with a number on the spine?

records.jp: あの数字は日本十進分類法に則って<CR>割り振られていると聞いたことがあります
records.en_original: Apparently that number is assigned according to the Dewey Decimal System.
records.en_auxiliary: Apparently that number is assigned according to the Dewey Decimal System.
records.en: I've heard those numbers are assigned<CR>according to the Nippon Decimal Classification.

records.jp: へー、よく知ってるね
records.en_original: Wow, I never knew that!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, I never knew that!
records.en: Wow, you know a lot.

records.jp: でも、その方法を使ったとして、<CR>いざ取り出す時にパッと思い出せるのかなぁ……
records.en_original: I'm not sure if I'd be able to memorize all those different numbers...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure if I'd be able to memorize all those different numbers...
records.en: But even if we use that method,<CR>will we remember it right away when we need a book...?

records.jp: よく使う本が上にくるように重ねた方が<CR>効率的な気もする
records.en_original: It might be more efficient to put the books we use most often at the top.
records.en_auxiliary: It might be more efficient to put the books we use most often at the top.
records.en: I feel like it might be more efficient<CR>to stack frequently used books on top.

records.jp: 「よく使う本」って定義が曖昧じゃない？<CR>人それぞれでしょ？
records.en_original: How do we decide what we use most often? Everyone likely uses different books at different times.
records.en_auxiliary: How do we decide what we use most often? Everyone likely uses different books at different times.
records.en: Isn't the definition of "frequently used" vague?<CR>It differs from person to person.

records.jp: シンプルに著者かタイトルで五十音順に<CR>並べるのが一番だと思うけど
records.en_original: It would probably be easiest just to put them in alphabetical order, either by author or by title.
records.en_auxiliary: It would probably be easiest just to put them in alphabetical order, either by author or by title.
records.en: I think the simplest way would be to arrange them<CR>by author or title in Japanese syllabary order.

records.jp: 星崎さんはどう思いますか？
records.en_original: What do you think, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think, Ao?
records.en: What do you think, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: え、私！？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?!
records.en: Huh? Me!?

records.jp: ていうか、私たちの話聞いてた？
records.en_original: Are you even listening?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you even listening?
records.en: Were you even listening to us?

records.jp: いや、聞いてはいたけど、<CR>正直どうでも……
records.en_original: I was listening, but I feel like anyway works...
records.en_auxiliary: I was listening, but I feel like anyway works...
records.en: I was listening, but<CR>honestly, I don't really care...

records.jp: （と言ってもみんな真剣な顔で話し合ってるし、<CR>ここは誰かの意見に乗るか）
records.en_original: (Everyone seems to be taking this quite seriously, I should probably choose just one thing.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Everyone seems to be taking this quite seriously, I should probably choose just one thing.)
records.en: (Still, everyone's discussing this so seriously,<CR>so I guess I'll side with one of them.)

records.jp: 図書館で採用されてる方法なら間違いないっしょ
records.en_original: If they use it at libraries, it must be good, right?
records.en_auxiliary: If they use it at libraries, it must be good, right?
records.en: If libraries use that method, it can't be wrong, right?

records.jp: 星崎さんもそう思います？
records.en_original: You think so too, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: You think so too, Ao?
records.en: You think so too, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: やっぱりプロの現場で使われているってことは<CR>それなりの理由がありますよね、きっと
records.en_original: I'm sure there is a good reason that professionals use it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure there is a good reason that professionals use it.
records.en: There must be a good reason<CR>professionals use it, after all.

records.jp: それに覚えておけば図書室で役立ちそうですし。<CR>一石二鳥です
records.en_original: Plus, it'll help us find stuff way quicker when we learn it. Two birds with one stone!
records.en_auxiliary: Plus, it'll help us find stuff way quicker when we learn it. Two birds with one stone!
records.en: And if we memorize it, it'll be useful in the library.<CR>Two birds with one stone.

records.jp: （たしかにこの方法なら勉強っぽくなく<CR>覚えられそう）
records.en_original: (I may actually be able to remember where everything is this way.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I may actually be able to remember where everything is this way.)
records.en: (True. With this method, I might remember it<CR>without it feeling like studying.)

records.jp: 日菜子さんに賛成かな。<CR>人それぞれって言ってもある程度被ってるでしょ
records.en_original: I guess I'd have to go with Hinako. Even if people read different books more than others, we'd still cover most of them this way.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I'd have to go with Hinako. Even if people read different books more than others, we'd still cover most of them this way.
records.en: I think I agree with Hinako-san.<CR>Even if it differs by person, there will be some overlap, right?

records.jp: うん、ここにある本は基本的に<CR>話し合いの参考資料として使うものだから
records.en_original: Yeah, the books here are basically used as reference material for discussion.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, the books here are basically used as reference material for discussion.
records.en: Yeah. The books here are basically<CR>reference material for our discussions.

records.jp: 私がよく使う本は「誰でも分かる地形学」と<CR>「一から学ぶ気象学」、「生物学基礎」……
records.en_original: The books I use most often are Geomorphology from the Ground Up and Meteorology for Stupids and Basic Biology...
records.en_auxiliary: The books I use most often are Geomorphology from the Ground Up and Meteorology for Stupids and Basic Biology...
records.en: The books I use often are Geomorphology Made Easy,<CR>Meteorology from Scratch, and Basic Biology...

records.jp: （分からないなりに学ぼうとする姿勢を<CR>すごく感じる……偉いなぁ）
records.en_original: (I'm so proud of Hinako... She's really trying to learn about all kinds of stuff.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm so proud of Hinako... She's really trying to learn about all kinds of stuff.)
records.en: (Even though she doesn't understand these subjects yet, I can really feel<CR>how hard she's trying to learn... That's admirable.)

records.jp: 伶那さんが言ってたのがいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Rena's idea sounds good.
records.en_auxiliary: Rena's idea sounds good.
records.en: Rena-san's idea sounds good, doesn't it?

records.jp: やっぱりルールは誰が見ても分かりやすい風に<CR>すべきだと思うの
records.en_original: I think it would be best to make it easy for anyone to understand.
records.en_auxiliary: I think it would be best to make it easy for anyone to understand.
records.en: I think the rules should be made<CR>easy for anyone to understand.

records.jp: その方が混乱しないし、<CR>イレギュラーが起こっても対処しやすいし
records.en_original: It's less likely to become disorganized and if there's a problem we can find it fast.
records.en_auxiliary: It's less likely to become disorganized and if there's a problem we can find it fast.
records.en: That way there'll be no confusion,<CR>and it'll be easier to handle irregularities.

records.jp: （もっともだけど、<CR>本の重ね方から起こるイレギュラーって何？）
records.en_original: (That's a strong argument, but what kind of problems are we expecting stacking books?)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's a strong argument, but what kind of problems are we expecting stacking books?)
records.en: (That's reasonable, but<CR>what irregularities can happen from stacking books?)

records.jp: 本の重ね方は決まったとして、<CR>何冊ずつに分ける？
records.en_original: Now that we've decided that, how high do we stack them?
records.en_auxiliary: Now that we've decided that, how high do we stack them?
records.en: Now that we've decided how to stack the books,<CR>how many should go in each pile?

records.jp: １０冊ずつくらいでしょうか
records.en_original: How about in stacks of ten?
records.en_auxiliary: How about in stacks of ten?
records.en: Maybe ten per stack?

records.jp: 倒した時危なくない？<CR>５冊くらいが無難だと思うけど
records.en_original: Sounds like it could be dangerous if someone knocked them over. How about five in a stack?
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds like it could be dangerous if someone knocked them over. How about five in a stack?
records.en: Wouldn't that be dangerous if they fell?<CR>I think five would be safer.

records.jp: だからそんなに分けたら場所取るって。<CR>ここは間を取って……
records.en_original: If we divide them like that it'll take up too much space...
records.en_auxiliary: If we divide them like that it'll take up too much space...
records.en: But if we divide them that much, it'll take up space.<CR>Let's split the difference...

records.jp: みんなのことは好きだけど
records.en_original: Listen, I think you're all great.
records.en_auxiliary: Listen, I think you're all great.
records.en: I like you all, but...

records.jp: 私、向こうの教室でよかった。本当に
records.en_original: But I'm so glad I'm in the other classroom.
records.en_auxiliary: But I'm so glad I'm in the other classroom.
records.en: I'm really glad I'm in the other classroom. Seriously.
